choice.description: Pay 1 gauge or destroy this card

en.plain:
[Call Cost] [Pay 1 gauge & Pay 1 life]
[An/Turn] "Parts Drop" When this card is destroyed by card effects, draw two cards.
At the end of the battle that this card attacked, you may pay 1 gauge. If you do not, destroy this card.
[Penetrate] [Double Attack]
